title: Auto submission
description: Submit P and G chart clears without recording a video. TUF checks the captured evidence and current official chart before registration.
connectDescription: Allow auto submission on the TUF sign-in screen while the game is running. Play from the beginning after connecting to capture a new submission.
notConfigured: Auto submission sign-in has not been configured yet.

eligibility.allowed: This account can submit trusted-tester clears.
eligibility.testerRequired: This account is connected, but trusted-tester access has not been granted.
eligibility.notAuthorized: This account cannot submit trusted-tester clears.
eligibility.stale: Submission access could not be refreshed. New capture is paused until it can be checked again.
eligibility.unavailable: Submission access could not be confirmed. New capture is paused until it can be checked again.

captureDescription: Collect eligible P and G clears so they can be submitted from the play menu.

visual.dmnoteCssHint: Replace the saved stylesheet. Missing fonts and images can be attached during registration.
visual.placementHint: Drag the keyviewer inside the 16:9 screen. Arrow keys move 1px; Shift+arrow keys move 10px. The dashed area includes the rain track.
visual.libraryDescription: Manage saved visuals to use in your submissions.
visual.registerDescription: Choose a source, then save it to your visual library.
visual.assetsHint: Attach each missing image or font. For a web address, attach the original file from that address. Files can be up to 48 MB each. Sounds and plugins are excluded from visual presets.
visual.sourceUnavailable: Mod or saved settings not detected
visual.dmnoteFileHint: Import a JSON export. The saved selected tab will be used.
visual.renameDescription: Change the name shown in your library and existing replays. The preset settings stay the same.
visual.renameFailed: The name could not be saved. Check the game connection and try again.
visual.renameRequiresUpdate: Update TUFReplay in the game, then reopen the visual library to rename this preset.
visual.deleteDescription: This removes the preset from your library. Previous submissions will show an empty {{kind}} slot the next time they load.
visual.nameTooLong: Preset names must be 80 characters or fewer.
visual.dmnoteFileRequired: Choose one DMNote or Impl DMNote JSON export file.
visual.error: The visual preset request failed. Try again.

errors.visual_name_too_long: Preset names must be 80 characters or fewer.
errors.visual_name_taken: That name is already in use. Choose another name.
errors.visual_source_unsupported: This source is unavailable for the selected visual type.
errors.visual_bundle_invalid: The source settings could not be imported. Check the original settings and try again.
errors.visual_asset_missing: Referenced images or fonts are missing. Include them in the source setup and try again.
errors.visual_payload_too_large: The upload exceeds the server limit. Reduce the preset image or font sizes and try again.
errors.visual_multiple_tabs: This DMNote export contains multiple tabs. Export one tab and choose its JSON file.
errors.visual_selected_tab_missing: The saved selected tab could not be found. Select a tab in DMNote or Impl DMNote and export the preset again.
errors.visual_preset_not_found: This visual preset no longer exists. Reload the library.
errors.visual_selection_conflict: This submission already has a fixed visual selection. Retry to use it.
errors.visual_request_failed: The visual preset request failed. Check the game connection and try again.
errors.visual_registration_busy: Another preset is being registered. Wait for it to finish, then retry.
errors.visual_registration_expired: Registration status is unavailable. Refresh the preset list before retrying to avoid duplicates.

visual.galleryDescription: Choose a preset for each tab, or leave both off and submit.
visual.galleryKeyviewerHint: Shows the keys you press during play.
visual.galleryOverlayHint: Shows play stats such as combo and accuracy.
visual.galleryNoVisuals: Ready to submit without extra visuals
visual.galleryEmpty: No saved presets yet. You can submit now without extra visuals.
visual.galleryListFailed: We couldn’t load your presets. Try loading them again to continue.
visual.galleryFixed: Your previous selection is saved. Retry the submission with the same visuals.
visual.connectHint: Connect your TUF account in General to manage visuals.
visual.emptyHint: Add a preset from your saved setup to use it in submissions.
visual.savedSetupHint: TUFReplay automatically imports the detected {{source}} saved settings. Save any changes in that mod before registering.
visual.sourceHint: Select the app your keyviewer or overlay comes from.
visual.nameHint: This name appears in your library. Choose any name, such as Numpad.
visual.chooseSourceFirst: Choose a source above to continue.
visual.detectionHint: If Jipper Resourcepack, Jipper KeyViewer, or ImplResourcePack is not detected, install the mod, save its settings once, and restart the game.

progress.title: Preset registration progress
progress.preparing: Preparing the selected settings and attachments…
progress.uploading: Checks complete. Sending and registering the preset…
progress.needs_assets: Checks finished. Attach the missing files to continue.
progress.failed: Registration stopped. Review the message below.

empty: Your captured plays will appear here. Clear a P or G chart with auto submission connected.
validatorUnavailable: Automatic validation is not available yet. Try again when it is ready, before the displayed evidence expiry date.
loginRequired: Sign in to TUF in this browser, then try connecting again.
requestFailed: This request could not be completed. Check your connection and TUF account, then try again.

progress.title: Submission progress

description.uploading: The game is sending your recording. Keep the game running until the transfer is complete.
description.saving: Upload complete. The server is saving your files and checking their integrity.
description.ready: Your recording is saved. Select Submit to choose your keyviewer and overlay, then send it to TUF.
description.validating: The server is checking whether this recording meets the submission requirements.
description.registering: Checks complete. The server is registering your result on TUF.
description.submitted: Your result has been registered. You can view it on TUF.
description.unavailable: The validation service is not available yet. Try again when it is ready, before your recording expires.
description.validationError: The server could not finish checking this recording. You can retry the submission.
description.registrationError: Registration could not finish. Retry to have the server check the result and resume registration.
description.validationRejected: This recording did not meet the submission requirements. Check the chart and game settings before recording another clear.
description.registrationRejected: TUF did not accept this result. Check your TUF account and the level’s submission requirements.
description.invalid: The server could not verify the recording files. Record another clear and let the transfer finish.
description.expired: The recording’s retention period has ended. Record another clear to submit this level.
description.unknown: The current stage could not be determined. Close this window and check again shortly.

reasons.chartMismatch: The chart’s gameplay differs from the official TUF chart. Play the official chart again; supported visual-only edits are allowed.
reasons.chartIdentity: This recording is missing supported chart verification data. Update the mod and record another clear.
reasons.chartAmbiguous: The server could not determine which chart in the TUF download is the official version. Ask the level manager to confirm the chart.
reasons.chartUnsupported: This chart uses gameplay features that submission checks do not support yet. Report the level to the developer.
reasons.chartChanged: The official TUF chart changed during submission. Retry to check against the current version.
reasons.authorization: Your account does not currently have submission permission. Check your TUF connection and account access in Settings.

progress.refreshFailed: The latest status could not be retrieved. Showing the last known stage; checking again automatically.
progress.disconnected: Connect your TUF account in Settings to check this recording’s status.
progress.canClose: You can close this window. Processing continues, and you can check here again.
progress.checkPermission: Submission access could not be confirmed. Check your TUF connection and account access in Settings.
